name: Skyfrost Nail
description: It is located at Dragonspine's summit. Access to this area is unlocked during the , and attempting to access this area beforehand by scaling the mountain will cause a unique Out of Bounds reaction before the player is teleported away. The area takes its name after the Celestial Nail that fell over the mountain from the heavens, freezing over the territory controlled by the ancient civilization of Sal Vindagnyr.
